target.title: Export closes the application on Windows
target.body: ReportDemo 1.4 on Windows 11 closes during CSV export. The dialog reports PermissionError: access denied. The destination is C:\Program Files\ReportDemo\report.csv.

candidates.title: PermissionError during CSV export on Windows
candidates.body: ReportDemo 1.3 on Windows 11 closes during CSV export to Program Files. The error is PermissionError: access denied. No root cause or fix has been verified.

candidates.title: Exported CSV contains rounded numbers on Linux
candidates.body: ReportDemo 1.4 on Ubuntu successfully exports CSV files, but decimal values are rounded. There is no crash or permission error.
